mapper.sql: id, course_name, course_days, feishu_material_path, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: insert into edu_course (course_name, course_days, feishu_material_path, status, created_at, updated_at) values (#{courseName}, #{courseDays}, #{feishuMaterialPath}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: update edu_course set course_name = #{courseName}, course_days = #{courseDays}, feishu_material_path = #{feishuMaterialPath}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select from edu_course
and ( course_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or feishu_material_path like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and status = #{status}
order by id desc
